about:
scripts/trace_graph.py — a traceability graph from requirement to commit, file and test
(.agent-rfc/designs/pass3-root-causes.md; phase 0 of .agent-rfc/designs/traceability-graph.md).

nodes.title: List the actions a person must approve
Name an accountable person for each agent
Tell people they are reading AI output
Map the Dubai AI Security Policy
Test in Arabic where Arabic is used
Audit every sign-in and human action
Business impact analysis and continuity plan
Require the gates through branch protection
Map the app to the UAE Charter
Classify the data and approve the boundary
Counsel opinion on the applicable laws
State the data class of every model call
Ship the declaration in the image
Explain a decision to the person affected
Fail the build on unfair results
Send every model call through the gateway
Every listed action reaches a named human gate
Incident plan, including withdrawing AI content
Confirm the ISR version and entity policies
Encryption at rest and key custody
Review logs and feed the SOC
Independent code review and penetration test
Scrub personal data before the model
Withhold answers that repeat the system prompt
Fill the risk register and accept residual risk
Reach models only through the sidecar
SSO with multi-factor; lock out repeated failures
A person can stop the app
Scan dependencies and declare MCP servers
Keep the trace store from reporting out
Design before code, review before done

REQ-B1.title: Design before code, review before done

OB-ISR-VERSION.title: Confirm the ISR version and entity policies

OB-AI-SECURITY-POLICY.title: Map the Dubai AI Security Policy

OB-COUNSEL.title: Counsel opinion on the applicable laws

OB-CLASSIFY.title: Classify the data and approve the boundary

OB-CHARTER.title: Map the app to the UAE Charter

OB-RISK.title: Fill the risk register and accept residual risk

OB-BRANCH.title: Require the gates through branch protection

OB-PENTEST.title: Independent code review and penetration test

OB-KEYS.title: Encryption at rest and key custody

OB-LOG-REVIEW.title: Review logs and feed the SOC

OB-BCP.title: Business impact analysis and continuity plan

OB-INCIDENT-PLAN.title: Incident plan, including withdrawing AI content

OB-AGENT-OWNERS.title: Name an accountable person for each agent

OB-AGENCY.title: List the actions a person must approve

OB-HITL-WIRING.title: Every listed action reaches a named human gate

OB-DATA-CLASS.title: State the data class of every model call

OB-PII.title: Scrub personal data before the model

OB-GATEWAY.title: Send every model call through the gateway

OB-SIDECAR.title: Reach models only through the sidecar

OB-FAIRNESS.title: Fail the build on unfair results

OB-ARABIC.title: Test in Arabic where Arabic is used

OB-SUPPLY-CHAIN.title: Scan dependencies and declare MCP servers

OB-DEPLOYED.title: Ship the declaration in the image

OB-TRACES-PRIVATE.title: Keep the trace store from reporting out

OB-STOP.title: A person can stop the app

OB-PROMPT-LEAK.title: Withhold answers that repeat the system prompt

OB-SIGNIN.title: SSO with multi-factor; lock out repeated failures

OB-AUDIT-COVERAGE.title: Audit every sign-in and human action

OB-AI-DISCLOSURE.title: Tell people they are reading AI output

OB-EXPLAIN.title: Explain a decision to the person affected
